intent: Combine a live service, clean contents and reduced access in one view. Keep moss absent; constrained operation must not look like either total shutdown or an unchanged vulnerable system. Visual distinction: A sieve with one narrow allowed aperture and stopped alternative lanes. Shows a reduced request surface without claiming all access is blocked. Pin the folder to its empty after rebuild state; the object silhouette persists while its status changes.
source:
**Location:** `artifactory-cache`

**Frame:** Wide view of the new Artifactory instance: clean cache, reduced credentials, blocked routes, live service. No moss accent.

**Action:** A concrete infrastructure compromise has received a concrete response.

**Font:** `narration`

**Caption:**
> THIS IS A REAL FIX TO A REAL FAILURE.

**Provenance:** `inferred` — project assessment grounded in documented mitigation effects.
title: A constrained service remains live
